recipe_title: Garlicky Spinach and Brown Rice Pilaf

details.title_candidate: Garlicky Spinach and Brown Rice Pilaf

details.summary: This is an excellent, straightforward recipe that perfectly leverages an everyday supermarket shortcut (the pre-cooked rice pouch) to deliver a balanced, high-fiber side dish well under the 30-minute limit.

dimensions.feedback: The flavor profile is classically Mediterranean and well-balanced: the earthiness of the brown rice and spinach is lifted by bright lemon juice/zest and grounded by savory garlic and rich walnuts.
All ingredients are accurately listed and used appropriately in the steps. No omissions or additions.

Excellent step-by-step instructions. Every cooking step includes a specific time range, a minimum-time check instruction, and clear visual/textural doneness cues (e.g., 'fragrant but not browned', 'fully wilted').
Perfectly aligned with the Mediterranean-American style, leaning on extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon, garlic, and leafy greens.
A quick skillet sauté is the ideal method for wilting fresh spinach and gently warming the pre-cooked rice without drying it out.
The computed nutrition panel accurately reflects the ingredients and portions. The macronutrient breakdown is entirely plausible.
The title is clear and accurate. The intro is warm, practical, and appropriately focuses on energy stability and fiber without making any exaggerated health or 'detox' claims.
A highly appealing, effortless everyday side dish. The walnuts add essential crunch, contrasting nicely with the soft rice and wilted greens.

Beautifully executes the book's dual mandate: it provides a measured, high-quality complex carbohydrate (brown rice) paired with abundant vegetables and heart-healthy unsaturated fats (olive oil, walnuts).
Zero added sugar. The carbohydrate component is high-quality (whole-grain brown rice) and appropriately portioned to provide stable energy for the T2D reader.

Fits perfectly in the 'Snacks & Sides' chapter as a measured whole-grain vegetable side. Note on the automated warning: while 25.1g of carbs is marginally over the 24g ceiling for a pure 'snack', it is entirely appropriate for a 'side' dish, which the intro correctly identifies it as.
Easily completed in 10 minutes. The use of a ready-to-eat cooked brown rice pouch is a smart, explicitly permitted everyday shortcut that delivers on the book's strict under-30-minute promise.
